=== probe api paths on public host ===
404  /

404  /actuator/health
000  /v3/api-docs
404  /swagger-ui.html

observation.command:
echo "=== probe api paths on public host ==="
for p in "/" "/api" "/api/v1/news" "/actuator/health" "/v3/api-docs" "/swagger-ui.html"; do
  code=$(curl -sS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:80$p" -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "$code  $p"
done
echo "=== direct container actuator (8081) ==="
docker exec urbo-workspace-spring-app-1 sh -c 'echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8081 && echo "8081 open"' 2>/dev/null
docker exec urbo-workspace-spring-app-1 wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8081/health 2>/dev/null | head -c 300; echo
echo "=== spring-app recent logs ==="
docker logs urbo-workspace-spring-app-1 --tail 15 2>&1 | grep -iE "started|tomcat|error|listen" | head -8
